registration.goof_case: round 10, lowest-seat NPC, every legal remaining root
registration.thanks_case: first nonforced NPC turn with remaining <= 3, every legal root
registration.worlds: Goof actual deterministic continuation; No Thanks actual future plus two independent public-unseen samples
registration.controller: same real adaptive decision, public learning and per-owner state after every revealed step
registration.required_reference: actual-root actual-world branch must exactly match stored final scores, credits and all beliefs
registration.labels: simulation teacher winner credit, NOT public real experience and NOT exact expected optimal values
registration.comparison: MC objective root, factual ridge root, actual personality root and same-state progress root vs sampled retrospective best

limitations: small late-game probe, same known rule families and controller profiles
one/three world labels do not establish exact expected action quality
future sampled-best selection is retrospective; no oracle values enter NPC decisions
